title: Contemporary Multi-Unit Terraced Residential Development
shortDescription: Contemporary two-storey multi-unit terraced residential development featuring stark white ground-floor colonnades, dark charcoal cantilevered upper volumes, glazed balcony balustrades, and full interlocking paved courtyard.
overview: A modern multi-unit terraced residential development showcasing clean geometric massing and coordinated external paving works. Each two-storey residence pairs a crisp white rendered ground-level entry colonnade with a contrasting dark charcoal upper facade, recessed window apertures, tinted glass balcony railings, exterior solar floodlighting, and a continuous interlocking concrete paver courtyard.
objectives: Deliver durable, low-maintenance contemporary multi-family residences with unified architectural rhythm, weather-resistant exterior finishes, and heavy-duty vehicular courtyard paving.
scopeOfWork: Superstructure masonry and reinforced concrete framing, cantilevered upper floor construction, multi-coat exterior screeding and two-tone painting, glass balcony balustrade installation, solar perimeter lighting, and interlocking driveway paving.
technicalApproach: Contrasting matte charcoal and bright white weather-shield exterior coatings protect the rendered blockwork envelope while cantilevered porch soffits shelter ground-level entryways and integrated courtyard drainage gradients channel surface runoff.
projectOutcome: Cohesive multi-unit residential terrace row delivered with crisp facade alignments, sheltered entry colonnades, and fully paved communal access.
